structural_rank_compactness_mean.name: structural_rank_compactness_mean
structural_rank_compactness_mean.meaning: Average of SII geometry-layer coherence_score (effective covariance rank / feature count). Captures structural dimensional compactness, not decision stability.
structural_rank_compactness_mean.caveat: Lower values can be normal for strongly coupled systems; do not read as decision incoherence.

decision_stability_mean.name: decision_stability_mean
decision_stability_mean.meaning: Mean per-unit stability score derived from action flips after warmup (1=no flips, 0=maximally unstable).
decision_stability_mean.caveat: Depends on warmup and action-availability windows.

early_signal_rate.name: early_signal_rate
early_signal_rate.meaning: Fraction of units with first canonical early-signal cycle at least lead_cycles_before_end before terminal cycle. Canonical early signal = decision available AND risk level in {medium, high} AND risk trend increasing.
early_signal_rate.caveat: Sensitive to lead-cycle requirement and risk-trend smoothing.

confidence_threshold_hit_rate.name: confidence_threshold_hit_rate
confidence_threshold_hit_rate.meaning: Fraction of units that reach decision.confidence >= configured threshold at least once.
confidence_threshold_hit_rate.caveat: Threshold-dependent; compare runs only with identical threshold.

action_flip_count_total.name: action_flip_count_total
action_flip_count_total.meaning: Total number of action label changes across all units after warmup.
action_flip_count_total.caveat: Counts only when decision actions are available.

attribution_alignment_coupled_mean.name: attribution_alignment_coupled_mean
attribution_alignment_coupled_mean.meaning: Mean of causal_analysis.attribution_causal_overlap_score; uses causal primary drivers seeded from attribution top sensors.
attribution_alignment_coupled_mean.caveat: Partially attribution-coupled and not an independence test.

attribution_alignment_independent_mean.name: attribution_alignment_independent_mean
attribution_alignment_independent_mean.meaning: Mean overlap between attribution top sensors and independent dominant drivers from score components (out['dominant_drivers']).
attribution_alignment_independent_mean.caveat: Still heuristic, but less self-referential than coupled overlap.
